# Test baseline — Fase 0 (Aug 2026)

Frozen list of tests that were failing BEFORE the KYB module work
began. Any *new* failure not listed here indicates a regression.

**Do NOT edit this file by hand to make new failures 'go away'.**
The right response to a new failure is to fix the code, not the
baseline. This list only shrinks (as pre-existing bugs get fixed
on their own initiative).

## How this file was built (Aug 2026)

Suite was run **three times back-to-back** in the same environment.
Failures that appeared in all three runs are listed under STABLE.
Failures that appeared in some runs but not others are listed under
FLAKY and treated separately — `scripts/check_test_baseline.py` does
not count a flaky test as a regression, but it does report its
status so trends stay visible.

Counts per run: 47, 49, 48.

## FLAKY (4)

These fail in some runs and pass in others in the same commit,
same environment. Not counted as regressions by
`scripts/check_test_baseline.py`, but new flakies **are**
reported so the list can be kept honest.

| # | Test node id |
|---|---|
| 1 | `tests/test_phase3_onboarding.py::TestSimulate::test_approved_flow_updates_app_org_and_audit` |
| 2 | `tests/test_phase3_onboarding.py::TestWebhooks::test_kyb_webhook_accepts_unsigned_in_sim_mode` |
| 3 | `tests/test_phase11_developer.py::test_webhook_create_returns_secret_once_and_test_endpoint` |
| 4 | `tests/test_phase6_clients.py::TestWebhooks::test_test_button_delivers_with_signature` |

Nota fila 4 (movida de STABLE, Fase 2): sensible a red — el botón de
prueba del webhook hace una entrega HTTP saliente real (mismo perfil
que la fila 3). Pasó completa en una corrida de baseline del
2026-06-11, falla en otras.

Nota fila 3 (agregada Fase 1): depende de una llamada de red externa a
`httpbin.org` (POST del webhook de prueba, timeout 15s). Pasa aislado
de forma consistente (verificado 3/3) pero puede exceder el timeout
bajo carga de suite completa o con latencia de red. Falló 1 vez en una
corrida de baseline el 2026-06-11 y pasó en la re-corrida inmediata.

## Regenerate

```
cd /app
for i in 1 2 3; do
  cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ --tb=no -q -p no:cacheprovider > /tmp/pytest_run_$i.txt 2>&1
  grep '^FAILED ' /tmp/pytest_run_$i.txt | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u > /tmp/failed_$i.txt
  cd -
done
comm -12 /tmp/failed_1.txt /tmp/failed_2.txt | comm -12 - /tmp/failed_3.txt > /tmp/stable_fails.txt
cat /tmp/failed_?.txt | sort -u > /tmp/all_seen.txt
comm -23 /tmp/all_seen.txt /tmp/stable_fails.txt > /tmp/flakies.txt
python scripts/check_test_baseline.py
```

## Running the guardrail suite with KYB_MODULE_ENABLED=true

From Fase 1 onward, the KYB routes only exist when the flag is on.
Both `scripts/check_test_baseline.py` and
`tests/test_admin_authorisation_guardrail.py` must pass in both
states (flag off = today's shape; flag on = today's shape + KYB
routes wired). Two-mode invocation:

```
# flag OFF (default):
cd /app && python scripts/check_test_baseline.py

# flag ON:
cd /app && KYB_MODULE_ENABLED=true python scripts/check_test_baseline.py
```

The guardrail test collects `app.routes` at import time, which
reads env vars once. Passing the env var on the command line is
sufficient; do **not** persist the flag on in shared config.
